body:
Part of #1379.

Choose the invisible cursor warm-up window's lifetime from QLibraryInfo::version(), the loaded Qt runtime. Qt6.11+ keeps it alive past bootstrap because QWindow destruction queries QAccessible::isActive and starts AT-SPI early. Older Qt keeps nightly's original stack-window creation/destruction path. The comment explains the version branch; using runtime rather than header version also covers an older native package loaded against newer Qt. AppImage's Qt6.12 follows the fixed path.

The runtime-version branch replaces the earlier timing claim. No new timing run is needed or claimed for Qt6.4.2/6.10's unchanged path. The strict test is unchanged: zero bridge connections before selector mapping, positive after.

Confirmed original regression on plain nightlycdac6e4b3174b59e0292b2a16af9abdd110e7514, f44 Fedora44 Qt6.11.2: one early connection where zero is expected. Minimal QWindow reproduction and gdb isolate the destructor; the existing QCoreApplication event-loop deferral still works for its original root-object trigger. [Original reproduction, gdb stack and raw results](https://github.com/patrick-hudson/put.gd-evidence/blob/6e734bf22e88b7717a1349be5c3825db11b24fc5/records/2026-11-10-small-fixes/README.md).

Head0125ada526addfa868503d26add510f9393bb4c1, source builds with official SDK and distro Qt, dev presets:

- f44 Qt6.11.2: capture_preparation_x11 PASS9.76s.
- m74 Mint22.3 Qt6.4.2: capture_preparation_x11 PASS7.82s.
- Physical m74 Cinnamon6.6.4/X11, lock held: real shortcut maps selector, drag captures400×250 local syntheticPNG, Escape cancels without another file. No extra window; xprop/xwininfo for helperPID3921334 shows only the selector and intended1×1 cursor child. The older-Qt warm-up has already been destroyed. Private XCURSOR_RESIZED=1 forces the fallback under test; the normal Qt6.4 static cursor seed skips warm-up.
- CI42745579753 is green at this exact head, including Ubuntu24.04/26.04 and required CI summary. Attempt1 lost only Ubuntu24.04 Install distro dependencies; failed jobs re-run successfully, no product test failure.

Before: plain nightly on f44.

[Current-head native frames, output artifact, xwininfo proof, source/binary identities, raw tests and clean release](https://github.com/patrick-hudson/put.gd-evidence/blob/ece43ce71323c7c4d0e9faf34dd1a261159f2855/records/2026-11-10-small-fixes-final/README.md). m74 lease released02:56:29UTC after visible idle; no installed package or user settings changed, no upload. Native source builds were used, no full package/release-matrix/memory campaign, workstation test, or new latency run. Complete current-head CodeRabbit review bodies checked, including Outside diff range comments: none; generic docstring warning answered, zero threads. No docs change and no merge performed.
